lines.text: Many learners say: I ate medicine.
We take medicine, we do not eat it.
Take! I take medicine every day.

data.why: We take medicine, we do not eat it.

native.hook: 薬を「食べる」は英語で言わない
native.tip: 薬は「飲む」でも take を使います。drink や eat は使いません。
native.caption: “I ate medicine.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「薬を飲む」を drink と訳しがちですが、英語では take medicine と言います。 “I took medicine.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“take”。薬は take。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Use take for medicine. Not eat or drink.
en.caption: Do you say “I ate medicine.”? 😅 You may translate kusuri wo nomu as drink, but English says take medicine. The natural way is “I took medicine.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
